Why does AWS recommend Cognito rather than calling AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity directly?

Cognito handles anonymous users, MFA and synchronization, and replaces a Token Vending Machine. It simplifies federation with Facebook, Google, OIDC, by creating least-privilege IAM roles with trust between the IdP and AWS.
Token Vending Machine
Believing a User Pool JWT gives direct access to S3: you need an Identity Pool to obtain AWS credentials.
Giving the guest role too many permissions: any anonymous visitor gets it.
